fields.explanationTl: Ang isang tailor ay 1 suit kada 6 days. Kahit 3 na sila, tig-isa lang sila, kaya 6 days pa rin.
fields.whyB: 3 days halves the time because the suits halved, ignoring that the tailors halved too.
fields.whyC: 12 days doubles the time for half the tailors, ignoring that the suits halved too.
fields.whyD: 9 days has no basis: tailors and suits both halved, so time is unchanged.
